title: Heat Geometry from a Universal Scalar Process
summary: We prove that the law of one smooth scalar process in a finite Wiener chaos completely determines finite families of symmetric tensors on arbitrary real separable Hilbert spaces, up to simultaneous orthogonal equivalence. Gaussian graph characters recover all contractions, while an intrinsic trace class Gram operator reduces the problem to finite dimensional invariant theory. Applied at a single fixed positive time to the canonical quadratic and quartic heat packet, this principle reconstructs the heat generator and forces every reconstructed unitary to be spatial.
